name: pace-maker
description: A per-conversation progress band for Claude Code: two rows above the prompt with task progress, what Claude is doing now, and why it stopped, at zero model tokens by default.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Show the progress band above the prompt

barStyle.title: Bar style
barStyle.description: smooth draws a gradient bar (terminal cells, or a vector bar in the desktop app and VS Code); blocks, thin, dots and ascii draw a plain text bar

showLabel.title: Show step label
showLabel.description: Show the name of the step in progress

showElapsed.title: Show elapsed time
showElapsed.description: Show how long the work has been running

showSubagents.title: Show subagents
showSubagents.description: Show how many subagents are running

explainStop.title: Explain why it stopped
explainStop.description: Uses AI: when Claude stops with steps left, one small-model call writes a short reason
